# v0.1.0 lockfile fixtures

`npm.flinttack.lock` and `npm.flinttack.lock.json` are the
`examples/npm/flinttack.lock` document produced by Flinttack tag `v0.1.0`,
kept so v1 → v2 migration stays covered forever.

The JSON file is a faithful encoding of the same document (not a
hand-simplified stand-in).
